content: ध्मा €1 <ab>P.</ab> (धमति, ध्मात; {%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} ध्मापयति) .²1 To blow, breathe out, exhale. .²2 To blow (as a wind-instrument), produce sound by blowing; शङ्खं दध्मौ प्रतापवान् <ls>Bg. 1. 12</ls>, <ls n="Bg. 1.">18</ls>; <ls>R. 7. 63</ls>; <ls>Bk. 3. 34</ls>, <ls n="Bk.">17. 7</ls>. .²3 To blow a fire, excite fire by blowing, excite sparks; को धमेच्छान्तं च पावकम् <ls>Mb.</ls> .²4 To manufacture by blowing. .²5 To cast, blow, or throw away.
